title: task.released v1
description: Release: the holder gives the task back, or the app takes it back from a disabled or removed seat, or from a seat whose landing prompt was issued again (GA-17). Carries a reason code from the registry, never text.

reason.description: The release reason, from the registry's release_reasons.

wait_cause.description: Why the wait_ready step this event opens is waiting: credential_limit when no seat is eligible only because no candidate is available and none is signed out, else null. Null when the event opens no wait_ready step. Fixed when the step opens (PRD, Rules for steps, rule 8).
